title: Buddy Johnson and the Imperial Brass Band, with advice to learn music
summary: Dominique worked with trombonist Buddy Johnson and recalls the Imperial Brass Band lineup, then urges young players to learn music.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Yeah, but all we want to know is what you know is that. What about Buddy Johnson?

Buddy Johnson trombone player. I worked with him. The time Manion sent me on job with him. He was a very nice fellow inspiration. Quiet guy. Little bit of fellow he was. He played with Manion Barrett's brass man too, don't forget. Played all those marches. He ain't doing marches. Just imagine what Manion had. Big gas for Buddy Johnson trombone and Joe Field. Three devils up in front there. Now you know he had some good men, eh? Yeah. That's why they call it the Imperial Brass Band. But they're all good musicians. And the last thing I want to tell the boys, whoever going to listen to this record better, please learn music and learn everything pertaining to music. I want that man. And forget that trash pop.
